title: 8/30 late pick: the fallback deferred an enterable pick on a stale plan and re-picked it after the cutoff (DM 13:36:14, cutoff 13:35); nothing alerted
tier_reason: the recommended pick was delivered after its entry cutoff and could not be entered; no monitor fired

contract.text: An enterable pick is delivered before the entry cutoff (first pitch minus 5 minutes of its earliest game), leaving the operator time to enter it; a fallback may defer only while a later confirmation window can still finish before that cutoff.

mechanism.text: the T-35 fallback refresh finished at 13:20 with the pick still enterable, then deferred it on a has_pending_future_window value snapshotted at 12:50 that counted the overdue 13:10 check and post-first-pitch checks as future windows

no enterability guard existed: candidate filtering keyed only on MLB game status and _deliver_and_lock_pick never looked at the clock, so the overdue 13:10 check locked and DMed the same pick at 13:36:14

each intraday cascade spent about 11 minutes asleep (pull_feeds slept 0.3 s after every cached feed, plus per-date discovery and a full parquet rebuild), stretching the refresh and the overdue check past the cutoff
fallback_defer validated 'never miss' as 'a delivered pick file exists', which was true, so no health source reported the late delivery

mitigated.action: operator hand-entered a different pick for the day

residual.text: No delivery_unknown non-scoreable terminal state for unconfirmed delivery attempts (review F2, deferred).
No feed-file validation or atomic temp-file downloads for the feed cache (review F10, deferred).
The cutoff is not enforced inside the Bluesky transport; a residual race of the transport's own seconds remains after the pre-send re-check (review F1).
The singleton-slate / moved-up-game gap is unchanged; the planner composes with it.
check_confirmed_lineups swallows per-game HTTP errors and reports 'nothing confirmed' (only makes the planner more willing to wait); a log line was suggested.

watchdog.trigger: a pick DM or pick-file delivered_at at or after the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 minutes, or a fallback deferral after which no enterable delivery can land before that cutoff
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the day's pick is delivered before the cutoff with the operator reserve (about T-10), or the delivery is refused, archived and alerted

evidence.what: checks 11:15 and 12:35 did not lock (gap to a projected contender); the 13:05 fallback refresh ended 13:20 and deferred; the overdue 13:10 check locked the same pick and DMed it at 13:36:14 against a 13:35 cutoff; nothing alerted; the operator hand-entered a different pick

evidence.locator: same memo §What the adversarial review corrected, §Round 2
evidence.what: root-cause ranking (stale sequential deadline-blind state machine = cause; missing delivery guard = containment failure; cached-feed sleeps = amplifier) and the deferred review items F1, F2, F10
the fix set per layer: hard cutoff guard at the delivery chokepoint, live re-pick without past-cutoff games, deadline-aware planner, no sleep on cached feeds, late_delivery health source
